section: Child Development & Pedagogy · Ch19 — NEP 2020 — Deep Practice
subject: Child Development & Pedagogy
stem: NEP 2020 seeks to transform assessment from being summative toward being:

options.option_text: Competency-based, formative and focused on higher-order thinking
Ranking students on a single high-stakes score
Entirely optional and left to parents

explanation: NEP 2020 promotes competency-based, formative 'assessment for learning', testing analysis and conceptual clarity rather than rote recall.

section: Child Development & Pedagogy · Ch16 — RTE Act — Deep Practice
subject: Child Development & Pedagogy
stem: Under the RTE Act, the School Management Committee (SMC) of a government/aided school must have at least what proportion of members from among parents/guardians?
explanation: Section 21 requires SMCs constituted with three-fourths (75%) parents/guardians, and 50% of members being women.
